record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The three units in appliesTo declare WISH: Togepi (1 star), Togetic (2 stars), Togekiss (3 stars); all have range 2 and maxPP 100 per the unit blocks. The strategy is shared; the only unit difference is the star count (shield table index). Units that merely evolve into or from these are not covered unless listed.
record.summary: Picks the unit of the caster's own team (the caster included) with the lowest current hp / maxHP fraction and gives it a shield (raw 30/60/120 by stars at 1-3 stars; AP-scaled) and a PROTECT status requested for 1500 ms. The in-source comment says '1 second', but the code passes 1500. Protect is not guaranteed: it is skipped if the chosen ally is already protected or enraged, while the shield is applied regardless.

targeting.who: the unit with the lowest hp / maxHP on the caster's team, the caster itself included; ties go to the unit that comes first in board.cells order (Array.sort is stable)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is false, so the strategy takes no enemy target (the target argument is null). Selection filters on team only: there is no check on hp > 0 or on the entity being on the bench or targettable, and the selected entity is not required to be damaged (a full-health team picks the first unit in scan order at hp fraction 1). Since the sort comparison uses hp / maxHP, a unit with maxHP 0 would give NaN; not traced. The strategy dereferences the result without a guard.

geometry.shape: no area; one ally anywhere on the board

effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] of the CASTER. PokemonEntity.addShield on the chosen ally: Big Eater Belt applies if the RECEIVING ally holds it (the helper takes the receiver as the entity and the caster as the source; x1.25 rounded down on a positive value); PokemonState.addShield with apBoost 1: x (1 + caster AP/100), x critPower of the caster only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so it needs ABILITY_CRIT), x0.5 if the RECEIVING ally is enraged, Math.round.
effects.resolution: requested (table) -> after the receiver's Big Eater Belt -> applied (after caster AP, crit, receiver enraged halving, rounding) -> added to the ally's shield, only if that ally's hp > 0; the shield stat is max(0, shield + value). No timer in this file; damage taken later consumes the shield first.

effects.scaling: none from stars, AP or crit; no duration-reduction helper is involved in triggerProtect
effects.resolution: requested 1500 ms -> applied only if the ally is not already protected and not enraged (a running protect is not extended and nothing is stacked); protectCooldown = 1500 and protect ends once the cooldown runs out in updateProtect. While protected: attacks on the unit are unsuccessful with 0 damage, handleDamage returns takenDamage 0 without death, ability damage is blocked in handleSpecialDamage, and heals are skipped. The protect call comes after the shield call, so a refused protect never prevents the shield.

shields: shield 30/60/120 (requested, raw; 240 only at 4 stars) on the lowest hp-fraction ally

starBehavior.note: Only the shield table is indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 4-star value 240 (also the ?? fallback) is not reachable at the bare factory star counts of these units. Protect duration does not vary by star. The in-source comment lists three values (30/60/120) while the code has a fourth. Whether other mechanics raise a star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None geometric. The choice depends only on the current hp fractions of the caster's team members found in board.cells; a lone caster shields and protects itself.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast spends maxPP of PP (floor 0), re-selects the lowest-fraction ally and adds a new shield (shields stack by addition). Protect cannot be stacked or extended: a second cast while the ally is still protected adds only the shield.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: shield 30/60/120 at 1-3 stars and a 1500 ms protect request. Applied shield = requested after the receiver's Big Eater Belt, the caster's AP, optional crit and the receiver's enraged halving, rounded; the shield only exists if the receiver's hp > 0. Applied protect = 1500 ms if the receiver is neither protected nor enraged, otherwise nothing. The comment's '1 second' is not what runs.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight and what requiresTarget = false changes in the generic targeting/casting flow (PP gain, silence, whether a target is required to start the cast) - only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate in the attack state and castAbility were read
Crit resolution - only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate was located
Whether board.cells can contain dead, benched or otherwise inactive entities of the caster's team, which the team-only filter would not exclude
unresolved: Whether a unit with hp 0 (dead but still on the board) or with maxHP 0 can be selected was not traced; the shield is skipped for hp 0 but the protect call would still run
What happens if board.cells has no entity of the caster's team (the result would be undefined); the caster is itself on the board during a cast, so this is not expected, but it was not traced
How Rune Protect, Skydive or other conditions interact with the ally protect was not read; only triggerProtect's own guards (already protected, enraged) were read
Whether the three units ever reach a different star count than the bare factory value
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks only
